Command.Name: ReadEJByCUInvoiceNum_JSON
Command.FPOperation: Read Electronic Journal Report by CU Invoice Number (Multiple invoices) in the JSON format. The number of bytes equal to Length for JSON data must be read subsequently.

Arg.Name: OptionInvoiceReportFormat
Arg.Desc: 1 character with value - 'N' - Detailed EJ - 'n' - Brief EJ

Arg.Name: StartCUInvoiceNum
Arg.Desc: 10 symbols for start CU invoice number in format: ##########.

Arg.Name: EndCUInvoiceNum
Arg.Desc: 10 symbols for end CU invoice number in format: ##########.
